## Hypothesis
The strategy aims to capture short-term directional moves by using volatility-filtered entries (vol_ratio_threshold) and a structured exit framework (chandelier profit-lock, fixed TP/SL, time stop) to manage risk while capturing gamma acceleration. The hypothesis is that tighter profit-taking (75% TP) and wider stops (35% SL) improve edge by reducing premature exits on runner trades while avoiding catastrophic losses.

## Mechanism
**Entry:** Triggered when internal volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (vol_ratio_threshold) and other proprietary conditions (not specified in keeper data).  
**Contract:** ITM-2 put (strike_offset=2) based on bearish setup context.  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at 75% premium gain (tp_premium_pct=0.75)  
- Stop loss at 35% premium loss (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% gain (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) with 15% trailing stop (implied v15 default)  
- Time stop: 12 minutes after entry if not exited by TP/SL
